data.gist: BMAX (ECM-retaining micronized bone marrow) outperformed conventional BMAC on pain behavior, joint swelling, and 8-week OARSI cartilage scores in rat DMM osteoarthritis.
data.plain: In a rat model of osteoarthritis caused by surgically destabilizing the meniscus, a bone marrow product that keeps its native extracellular matrix (BMAX) reduced pain-related behavior and joint swelling more than standard concentrated bone marrow aspirate (BMAC). It also showed better cartilage scores (lower OARSI histology grades) eight weeks after injection.
